subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: What should strict channel-delivery sanitization do when a model emits an unclosed `<think>` block followed by `<final>` answer text?
rationale: The current fallback can recover an answer but may expose hidden reasoning; changing it is a security boundary and product-semantics choice rather than a purely mechanical WhatsApp fix.

options.title: Fix the shared sanitizer boundary
options.body: Recover only validated final-answer text when a final marker exists, otherwise suppress malformed unclosed reasoning, and cover WhatsApp plus Telegram paths.

options.title: Fail closed on malformed reasoning
options.body: Suppress all strict-mode output after an unclosed reasoning opener unless the stream parser has already separated a final answer.

options.title: Patch channels separately
options.body: Add WhatsApp and sibling channel splitters while leaving the shared fallback unchanged, accepting continued drift risk across delivery surfaces.

recommendation.title: Fix the shared sanitizer boundary
recommendation.body: Recover only validated final-answer text when a final marker exists, otherwise suppress malformed unclosed reasoning, and cover WhatsApp plus Telegram paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history points to shared sanitizer and final-tag behavior owned around commits by this handle, making them the best routing candidate for the strict fallback decision.
